For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 4. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of KVS ZIET FUND ACCOUNT Account No.037622010001142 IFSC Code UBIN0903761 UNION BANK OF INDIA SIDDARTHLAYOUT payable at MYSURU . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. DD should be made in favour of KVS ZIET FUND ACCOUNT No.037622010001142 IFSC Code UBIN0903761 UNION BANK OF INDIA SIDDART HLAYOUT payable at MYSURU . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The service provider should register for the Service being offered by him in the office located in MYSURU/ BANGALORE – Karnataka State (documentary evidence for the same is to be submitted). The registration certificate registere d with the Labour Department as per Karnataka Shops and Establishment Act 1 961 is mandatory. The Service provider should be readily approachable and abl e to visit the site in short notice as an when required and should regularly carry out the supervision of the catering services. The vender is liable to be rej ected in case there is no Office in MYSURU / BANGALROE – Karnataka S tate and in case of not submitting the registration certificate registere d with Labour department in MYSURU / Bangalore – Karnataka State Ad dress as per the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishment Act 1 961. Rent agreement will not be accepted. 1. Registration Certificate from Govt. of Karnataka for Good Safety and Standards Authority of India – Registration Certificate under FSS Act – 2006.

2. Registration ID Card. 3. Certificate of Registration 4. MSME – Registration certificate 5. Trade Licence from Health Department 6. Govt. of Karnataka Department of Labour – Registration Certificate of Establish ment 7. PAN Card / Audit Reports . 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Provision of food to participants of various courses in the Institute as per tentati ve menu enclosed. The ZIET organizes 03 to 10 -days training programs in diffe rent spells throughout the year for about 250 to 265 days and catering services are to be provided to the participants of the programs. The number of participa nts for each training program ranges from 40 to 80 and the number of courses expected to be conducted will be around 50. 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 14.
